purpose: Train one controlled SmolVLA matched pair while LocalSim pilot work remains independent.
research_question: Under one fixed SmolVLA recipe, does adding the frozen aligned Quest-Sim48-v7 demonstrations to Real24 improve Task 1 PickLift performance relative to Real24-only?

task_and_feature_contract.exact_training_task_text: Task 1 PickLift v1: grasp the 2 cm red cube and lift it >=5 cm with bilateral finger hold

input_features.observation.images.front: front-only VISUAL input, loader shape float32[3,480,640]

task_and_feature_contract.units: first five joints in degrees; gripper 0=closed and 100=open

mandatory_pre_optimizer_gates: Recompute the frozen data, base, VLM, dependency-lock, and implementation-source inventories from the Phase A manifest.

Override the official base's three placeholder camera features with exactly observation.images.front plus observation.state; saved run config and normalizer features must contain no camera1, camera2, camera3, image, image2, image3, wrist, or handeye feature.

Bind policy.vlm_model_name and the tokenizer processor tokenizer_name to the exact same frozen local VLM snapshot path, not to a mutable repository name; record both resolved paths and generated config hashes.
Initialize each smoke and full run independently from the exact frozen policy base; do not resume from smoke, another condition, an ACT checkpoint, or an intermediate SmolVLA checkpoint.
Refuse the run if any frozen identity, task text, feature, joint order, shape, dtype, FPS, snapshot path, or dependency hash differs.

common_recipe.checkpoint_selection: step 20000 only; no selection by loss, intermediate checkpoint, simulation result, or real result

normalization.state: MEAN_STD from that condition's frozen training dataset
normalization.action: MEAN_STD from that condition's frozen training dataset

predeclared_execution_order.gate: A full run completed under this frozen contract

smoke_acceptance: Exactly 500 optimizer steps complete with finite losses and gradients.
The step-500 artifact reloads from a new output directory and produces finite offline actions through its saved processor.
The saved policy and processor prove front-only features and exact local policy/VLM/tokenizer bindings.
No smoke checkpoint is used to initialize either full run.
full_run_and_offline_validation_evidence: Record the exact command, start/end UTC, duration, GPU, dependency versions, environment variables that affect loading, seed, dataset identity, sampler counts, config hashes, log hash, and output inventory.
Record consumed Real and Sim sample counts; B must remain exactly 32 Real plus 32 Sim per batch with no within-epoch duplicate or oversampling.
Hash and select only the step-20000 checkpoint for each condition; intermediate artifacts cannot be selected using observed metrics.

Reload each fixed step-20000 checkpoint with its own saved processor and verify finite expected-shape offline inference on a frozen Real sample; also verify the B checkpoint on a frozen Quest-Sim48-v7 sample.
Write immutable per-run manifests plus a matched-pair summary and independently verify their hashes.

authorized: two fixed 20000-step offline CUDA training runs after smoke gates pass
checkpoint hashing, reload, and finite offline inference
local owning-repository commits and immutable small evidence manifests
not_authorized: hardware, serial, robot, torque, 12V, or hardware-camera access
Quest, Remote service, MuJoCo, LocalSim, or real-robot rollout
Dataset mutation, new collection, Local pilot data, Sim24, or quarantined Sim48-v6
training extension beyond 20000 steps, hyperparameter tuning, retrying by outcome, checkpoint switching, or push

confirmed_engineering_facts: Phase A independently verified both frozen datasets, both model snapshots, the dependency lock, the front-only need, the 1:1 sampler, official Dataset loading, and batch-64 CUDA capacity without an optimizer step.

The two Phase B conditions differ in training data and sampler composition; their SmolVLA architecture, initial weights, task text, feature contract, optimization recipe, seed, steps, and selected checkpoint rule are fixed alike.
research_classification.research_hypothesis: The aligned Quest-Sim48-v7 demonstrations may improve downstream real Task1 performance under SmolVLA relative to Real24-only.
unresolved_choices: Whether either 20k checkpoint has useful simulation or real-robot performance.
Whether 20k is sufficient for SmolVLA convergence.
Whether any future evaluation result is stable enough for a paper claim.
requires_future_evidence: offline Phase B completion and immutable checkpoint evidence
a separately frozen matched evaluation before any performance statement
paper-scale real-robot trials before a paper claim
